settings.title: Useful beats flashy.
settings.text: New golfers need accessories that make the round easier, not more complicated.

settings.title: Stay neutral if you do not know the bag.
settings.text: Black, white, navy, green, and gold accents are safer than loud novelty colors.

settings.title: Start with the Starter Setup.
settings.text: A towel, marker, and small tool path feels useful without overwhelming someone still building their routine.

settings.title: Avoid niche gear
settings.text: Do not assume they need advanced tools or swing aids first.

settings.title: Give everyday pieces
settings.text: Towels, brushes, markers, and simple desk gifts are easier to use immediately.

settings.title: Keep it matched
settings.text: Even a beginner gift feels more premium when the colors look planned.

settings.title: Golf Desk Gifts
settings.text: Easy off-course gifts for new golf people.

settings.title: Build Your Bag
settings.text: Use the builder if you know their bag color.

settings.heading: Give something they will actually use.
settings.subheading: A gift guide for newer golfers: practical, clean, and matched without making the sport feel more complicated.
